normalization_note: Claude returned the artifact digest key as 'sha'; it is recorded as the repository-standard 'sha256' without changing the value. Findings and verdict are otherwise transcribed without substantive alteration.

findings.finding: Memory saving is unverified: the 9.45 GiB forecast assumes at least 0.481370 GiB reduction from the v3 peak RSS of 9.931370 GiB driven solely by lowering ILU fill from 2 to 1.
findings.disposition: Direction is supported by installed ADflow documentation, but mesh-specific magnitude is unknown. Keep the fail-closed watchdog authoritative and never retry automatically.

findings.finding: The 9.45 GiB forecast is 74.617 percent of WSL-visible memory, leaving only about 0.05 GiB below the 75-percent prelaunch ceiling.
findings.disposition: Require a fresh same-session resource snapshot and all existing prelaunch gates immediately before authorization consumption.

findings.finding: Lowering ANK and NK ILU fill weakens the approximate linear preconditioner, so memory saved may be offset by slower or stalled convergence.
findings.disposition: Accepted as efficacy risk, not host-safety risk. Preserve unchanged convergence semantics and record a solver outcome if it does not converge.

findings.finding: The v3 solve stopped at nonlinear iteration 15 before satisfying unchanged full convergence criteria; successful completion is not established by the prior partial history.
findings.disposition: Authorize only a single measurement attempt, not an aerodynamic verdict or campaign.

findings.finding: The independent mesh GO is conditional and limited to one measurement.
findings.disposition: Do not generalize v4 to other runs.

findings.finding: External Windows or WSL pressure can lower live MemAvailable because the Windows host has 16 GB physical RAM and WSL remains capped at 13 GB.
findings.disposition: Treat launch timing and live preflight as binding.

findings.finding: One MPI rank provides no memory-distribution lever.
findings.disposition: Keep rank identity unchanged; do not improvise parallel decomposition.

rationale: The proposal is a minimal, physically motivated, correctness-preserving one-shot engineering attempt. It changes only the approximate linear preconditioner and iteration path, not the converged nonlinear RANS/SA equations. The prior run demonstrated controlled progress and correct watchdog behavior with no OOM or swap growth. Residual efficacy uncertainty is bounded by the unchanged fail-closed resource controls and one-shot governance. No HIGH finding is present.
conditions: Use a fresh v4 authorization; never reuse or retry consumed v3 authorization.

Immediately before launch, require forecast 9.45 GiB plus 2.0 GiB to fit live MemAvailable, forecast at or below 75 percent WSL-visible memory, preexisting swap at or below 0.25 GiB, adequate disk, exact hashes, successful real one-rank MPI probe, and all identity checks green.

The only permitted solver-option deltas versus v3 are ANKPCILUFill 2 to 1 and NKPCILUFill 2 to 1. Retain ANKSubspaceSize 10, NKSubspaceSize 20, ADflow 2.13.1, one rank, RANS/SA, and all flow, mesh, reference, convergence, and output settings.
Keep the full-session watchdog unchanged: MemAvailable floor 2.0 GiB, swap-growth limit 0.25 GiB, OOM monitoring, two-second sampling, and terminate-and-record on any breach.
Development-only measurement; no ACCEPTED classification and no holdout access.
Retain every log, residual history, option dump, watchdog sample, and surface output regardless of outcome.
Any further attempt after any terminal outcome requires a new independent review.

independence_and_limits.source_facts_supplied_by: Codex from committed repository and installed ADflow evidence
independence_and_limits.statement: This resource-plan GO is not by itself CFD authorization. The mesh GO, exact hash binding, green tests/MPI/preflight, and the user's explicit instruction are also required.
